question: 12-team half-PPR, my TE is George Kittle and my WR is Davante Adams. Who becomes the Bucs' WR1 if Mike Evans is out?
answer:
Deebo Samuel is next at WR on the depth chart, but the target share points to Christian McCaffrey (22.8%), so for fantasy: pick up Christian McCaffrey.
